Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner.

Token constructor setting metadata, total supply and minting the whole supply.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of the given owner address.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath.
Sets the allowance a spender may use on behalf of msg.sender.
Moves tokens between accounts using a pre-approved allowance.
Reads the remaining allowance from tokenOwner to spender.
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts incoming ether.
Owner-only rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance authorization.
Unchecked-by-compiler addition c = a + b guarded only by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b guarded only by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b guarded by an overflow check on the result.
External call to spender.receiveApproval with attacker-controlled spender and data.
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress.transfer, reachable only by the owner.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().

edges.reason: Owned() constructor reads msg.sender to establish the privileged owner role.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] directly from caller-controlled input.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approveAndCall sets allowance for msg.sender before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stages the supplied address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after transfer.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner slot.
CASHBACK constructor writes the token symbol.
CASHBACK constructor writes the token name.
CASHBACK constructor writes the decimals value.
CASHBACK constructor fixes the total supply.
CASHBACK constructor mints the full supply to the deployer address.
transfer mutates sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
approve overwrites the allowed allowance entry.
transferFrom moves balances from the source to the destination.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before invoking the callee.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried address.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub on balances and on the allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
safeAdd evaluates c = a + b relying solely on require(c >= a).
safeSub evaluates c = a - b relying solely on require(b <= a).
safeMul evaluates c = a * b with a post-hoc overflow check.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)].
approveAndCall performs an external call to the attacker-supplied spender contract.
receiveApproval executes arbitrary attacker code that can re-enter the token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary external contract.
the arbitrary external call executes foreign code that may re-enter the contract.

safeAdd consumes parameter b as the second addend.

safeSub consumes parameter a as the minuend.
safeSub consumes parameter b as the subtrahend.
safeSub writes the difference into the local return variable c.

safeMul consumes parameter b as the second factor.
safeMul writes the product into the local return variable c.
safeDiv consumes parameter a as the dividend.
safeDiv consumes parameter b as the divisor.
safeDiv writes the quotient into the local return variable c.
transferOwnership reads the _newOwner parameter.
balanceOf reads the tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf writes the queried balance into the return variable.

transfer uses the tokens parameter as the amount.

approve uses the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
approve sets the success return flag to true.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as the debited account.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credited account.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the transferred amount.
transferFrom sets the success return flag to true.
allowance reads the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads the spender parameter.
allowance writes the result into the remaining return variable.
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter as both allowance key and external callee.
approveAndCall uses the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
approveAndCall forwards the data parameter into the external callee.
approveAndCall sets the success return flag to true.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the tokenAddress parameter as the external callee.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the tokens parameter as the forwarded amount.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the external call result as success.
